Tawwa wa9teh ahna nesta3mlouh l simple present?
→ kif nhebou nahkiyou ala haja tet3awed dima mathalan Ahmed kol nhar yemchi lel
madersa (Ahmed goes to school every day); something happens repeatedly.. zeda kif
na7kiew 3le hakika 3ema wlee 3ilmia mthalan: el mee ya8li 3nd 100 darajee mi2awia: « water
boils at 100 degrees » wlee chames tochre9 mn char9 « the sun rises in the east. », one
action follows another, with verbs like (to love, to hate, to think ....) mathalan Asma t7eb
ta9ra riweyet: « Asma likes to read novels. » how often things happen.
Rule: m3e: I, they, we, you + verb without to and without S (ya3ni base form of the verb) for
example: I eat, they play.
M3e she, he, it nzidou lel verb « s » for example: she plays, he plays.. hedha benesba lel
affirmative form.
Ema fi negative form n3mlou subject + do (I, they, we) wle does (kif nal9ou she, he, it) + not
+ base form of the verb (ya3ni mn 8ir s w mn 8ir to) example: I do not eat, she does not play.
Ema fi interrogative form n3mlou do wlee does + subject + base form of the verb. example:
do you eat? does she eat?
Examples: I work → I don't work → Do I work? → He works → He doesn't work → Does
he work?
Present Progressive: signal words mtaaou houma:
now, at the moment, look, listen, right now, currently, these days, today, this

Chnouwa houwa l indirect speech? kif tebda bech taawed klem had amma ala lsanek enty
wella bech tfaser klem had donc naamlou "report" leklamou. Mil direct ll indirect speech
famma barcha hajet ttbadel selon tense mtaa reporting verb kima personal pronouns,
possessive pronouns and adjectives w fil reporting speech the quotation marks ( !, ", ?, : )
yetna7aw. Reporting verbs elli en général nestaamlouhom houma tell, say, ask; kima
naajmou nestaamlou announce, complain, order, reply, answer, explain,...
Examples: My sister says, "I'm going to visit my friend." → My sister says she's going to visit
her friend. (tense used is the present).
He said, "I love Tunisia. I'm not myself unless I'm here." → He said he loved Tunisia and he
wasn't himself unless he was there. (tense used is the past).
